description:
Land Acquisition - Kovana, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Kossinna, Delpitiya, Hippola, Pathahewaheta D/S Division, Kandy District - Tumbowila, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District
(Section 38 (4))
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land allotments being divested by the Minister, including precise location details, lot numbers, extents, and boundary descriptions. While it mentions a government minister (Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando), this is incidental to the core land-related administrative action. The content focuses exclusively on land transactions and property matters, fitting squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
